listen_addresses.description: IP addresses the Mandos server will bind to (e.g., ['127.0.0.1', '192.168.1.10'] — leave as ['127.0.0.1'] to only accept local connections)

port.description: TCP port on which the Mandos server listens for client requests

keys_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing encrypted LUKS keys and associated metadata files (one .key file per client)

plugins_dir.description: Directory containing XML-RPC plugins (leave default unless you have custom plugins)

max_clients.description: Maximum concurrent client connections to support

log_level.description: Verbosity of server logging: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

verbose.description: Enable extra verbose logging (includes request/response payloads)

ssl_enabled.description: Whether to use TLS/SSL encryption for client-server communication

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (required if SSL is enabled)

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (required if SSL is enabled)

ssl_ca_file.description: Optional path to a CA certificate bundle to verify client certificates (mutual TLS)

ssl_crl_file.description: Optional path to a certificate revocation list (CRL) for revoked client certs

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed client hostnames or IP addresses. Leave empty to allow all (not recommended for production)

use_systemd_socket.description: Whether to use systemd socket activation (recommended for security hardening)

description.description: Brief description of what the plugin does

plugins.description: List of XML-RPC plugins to load. Each plugin provides custom behavior (e.g., logging, pre/post hooks)
